sentences.en: As many as fifty students gathered to hear his lecture.
sentences.zh: 多达五十名学生聚集在一起听他的讲座。

sentences.en: Fifty of the machines are running at the present time.
sentences.zh: 目前有五十台机器在运行。

sentences.en: I pay fifty pounds a week for board and lodging.
sentences.zh: 我每周支付五十英镑作为食宿费用。

senses.zh: 五十；五十个；编号为50的东西
五十的；五十个的；众多的形容词:fifty
